id: title:DanielVisca:add a shared builder for metrics deep links

observations.behavior: Defines shared URL parameters for the Metrics Viewer including aggregation, date range, filters, etc.
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes a single source of truth for how PostHog serializes state into shareable URLs; downstream components use these helpers instead of hand-crafting query strings.

observations.behavior: Provides a helper to wrap service-specific filters in the exact nested structure expected by the scene parser.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows other products or pages to link directly into a scoped metrics view without duplicating parsing rules or risking mismatch with `metricsSceneLogic`.

observations.behavior: Adds an explicit flag distinguishing user-chosen aggregations from defaults and only applies backend recommendations when no deliberate choice exists.
observations.posthog_connection: Preserves intentional user selections while still recovering missing metadata on cold loads, preventing unwanted overrides that could change chart behavior unexpectedly.

observations.limitations: Only frontend TypeScript changes are shown. No tests demonstrate runtime failure recovery or compatibility with existing dashboards. The tier is conservative because shared URL contracts can have broader impact but this chunk does not show systemic adoption or cross-component dependency resolution.

review.limitations: Only frontend TypeScript changes are shown. No tests demonstrate runtime failure recovery or compatibility with existing dashboards. The tier is conservative because shared URL contracts can have broader impact but this chunk does not show systemic adoption or cross-component dependency resolution.
review.reason: This chunk establishes a bounded capability: it adds typed parameters for sharing metric views and preserves user intent against automatic recommendation. This matters for PostHog users who share links; however, there is no evidence of wider system-wide benefit or risk reduction across components.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to dashboard usability and shareability. It helps prevent incorrect charts after deep-linking, which supports reliability and team collaboration.
review.uncertainty: Could be higher-tier if the implementation were shown alongside migration or compatibility handling, but absent such context we cannot assume broader systemic value.
